note: Runnable witness producers that build mpmath values and never raise working precision, so they compute at mpmath's default 15 dps. The backlog is tolerated; it must only SHRINK. Adding a file here to silence a failure defeats the gate — call set_compute_dps() instead.
enforced_rule: AGENTS.md: NO-FLOAT64. A producer that never raises dps emits honestly-float64 numbers, which the padding and raw-float64 scans cannot see.
why_runnable_only: mp.dps is GLOBAL, so an imported helper inherits its caller's precision and is not a defect. Only files with a __main__ guard are counted.
